direct_publisher_checks.result: Latest Gaza reports remain November 8 Deir al-Balah sand-cliff collapse update at 21:17 Gaza local; Khan Younis two fatalities at 17:49. November 8 late news on homepage relates to West Bank or non-Gaza subjects.
Direct homepage fetch timed out. English WAFA remained available; targeted Arabic queries returned no verified later distinct Gaza incident.

November 9 story on Deir al-Balah landslide provides a differing description of five deceased (one woman and four children) compared with WAFA's woman and three children; same five-death incident, not additional casualties. Later EU appeal refers to ongoing storm, not documented aid or access change.
